page.title: Device management
page.subtitle: Zero-touch provisioning via Headscale SDN
page.step1: Factory flashes the device with its certificate and Claim Code.
page.step2: Your team enters the Claim Code from the chassis label on this page.
page.step3: For KLinux devices (rovers, gateways), a Tailscale pre-auth key is generated automatically.
page.step4: The device connects to the Headscale SDN and appears online.
page.step5: ESP32 sensors connect via MQTT mTLS — no VPN key needed.

list.emptyHint: Use “Add device” to activate the first one.
list.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{{name}}”? This will disconnect the device immediately.

wizard.title: Activate device
wizard.formIntro: Enter the hardware UUID and Claim Code printed on the device chassis.
wizard.claimHint: Printed on the device chassis label.
wizard.tailscaleCmd: Run on the device: tailscale up --login-server={{server}} --authkey=<KEY>
wizard.esp32Note: ESP32 device activated. It will connect via mTLS certificate.
wizard.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
wizard.errorQuotaExceeded: Device quota exceeded ({{used}}/{{max}}). Contact your administrator.
wizard.errorDeviceAlreadyActivated: This device has already been activated.
wizard.errorDeviceRevoked: This device has been revoked and cannot be reactivated.

factory.title: Factory — Pre-register Device
factory.description: Register a new device and generate its Claim Code for chassis printing.

revoke.title: Revoke device
revoke.consequences: This will immediately disconnect the device from the SDN. It cannot be reactivated.
